gloss: endnote; note placed after the text

definitions.gloss: endnote; note placed after the main text
definitions.explanation: An annotation gathered after the main text—at the end of a chapter or the whole work—rather than at the foot of each page. Contrasts with {脚注|きゃくちゅう} (footnote), which sits on the same page as the reference.

examples.japanese: {後注|こうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{後注|こうちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This paper uses endnotes rather than footnotes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて{後注|こうちゅう}にした。
examples.english: Prioritizing readability, we moved all the annotations to endnotes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {後|こう} (after, later) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (note, annotation). Literally "a note placed afterward."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{巻末注|かんまつちゅう}→巻末注：29711_kanmatsuchuu⟧: endnote — a near-synonym stressing placement at the very back of the book
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — a note at the foot of the same page
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation, commentary — the general term
